abstract: A very rare case of mesenteric teratoma, detected by routine ultrasound screening at 20 weeks' gestation, is reported. The patient, a male newborn delivered at 40 weeks' gestation in good condition, was successfully operated on at birth. The post-operative course was regular and the baby is currently doing well.
abstract_ja: 超音波スクリーニングにより妊娠20週で検出された、非常にまれな腸間膜奇形腫の症例を報告する。患者は妊娠40週で出生した状態良好な男児で、出生直後に手術を受けた。術後経過は順調で、現在も良好である。
